upgrade_2026-10-20.instruction: rewritten to state one general property over the protected outcome (what may be stored as an image and what stored image content may contain). Every route, operation, source, format and sibling enumeration was removed, including the observed-impact route and the accepted-format list; the coupled contracts were kept in property terms (configured formats and aliases, contents-vs-name, undecodable-but-accepted formats, vector files stored after sanitizing, non-image data unaffected, name preservation, and an unusable image leaving its feature usable).
upgrade_2026-10-20.coverage: no new lever was needed: the task already has how-type levers (M4 on the import, inliner, avatar and mention-icon routes; M8 on the upload extension/declared-type differential and on the shallow-sanitizer and diversion shapes; M11 on the coupled alias/case/mismatched-name/undecodable values). Every writer of image storage is covered by a failing security test except the link-preview image path, which already holds the property at the pinned commit; a security test for it would pass at the pin and invalidate nop. No test, solution, environment or check file changed.
